name: Slider-driven counter
purpose: One input drives one output: a handle drags along a track, the input readout steps and the output rolls, settles in small steps and holds; an optional caveat states the assumption.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.slider(parent, data) -> {enter, drag(tl, at, {to, duration 1.7, settle 2}), caveat(tl, at), exit}; call drag in time order

layout_notes: Fills its parent's width; readouts over the track; the output is the largest text on screen.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-slider-ui/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
